note: Plain-language facts for the cantina owner's world briefing (M12). PromptBuilder turns WorldState flags into these lines.
place: WHERE YOU ARE: your bar is in %s, your home town, on the planet %s; this is the place you know by name. Use these two names and never invent other place names for here.
people: PEOPLE IN TOWN YOU KNOW BY NAME: %s.
town: THE TOWN (give directions with these landmarks, never compass points): The town is round, inside a round wall. The front gate is the big gate with the Remnant checkpoint and a watchtower on each side; most traffic comes and goes through it. Just inside the front gate the market is on one side, three curving aisles of stalls with shops round the edge, and the barracks on the other, with its yard and drill ground. The landing pit, a big round bowl where ships set down, is in the middle of town, down a ramp, with landing pads on the ring road round it. The cantina, a round club with a lookout tower beside it, is at the far end of town from the front gate. The houses wrap round the back of town on both sides, the low huts on the market side and the tall towers on the barracks side, until they almost meet behind the cantina. Between them a lane runs out to the back gate, a gap in the wall just wide enough for a speeder. Skrugs's yard is on that lane right behind the cantina: his speeder stall, his house and his garage. Nomad packs roam the desert; they are sometimes hostile, and trade food only. They are scavengers and have every type of equipment or item.
